find:
<button class="ui-btn ui-btn--slab hud-versus-back" type="button">Back</button>
        <button class="ui-btn ui-btn--primary hud-versus-start" type="button">Start</button>
replace:
<button class="ui-btn ui-btn--primary hud-versus-start" type="button">Start</button>
        <button class="ui-btn ui-btn--slab hud-versus-back" type="button">Back</button>
why: Document order reversed while the stylesheet keeps rendering Back on the left, so the keyboard walk and the screen disagree: focus lands on the RIGHT button first and then moves left. Invisible to a mouse and to a screenshot, and exactly the divergence the markup ordering exists to prevent -- the alternative implementation, a CSS order property, would have had this defect permanently.
killedBy: hud: the versus action bar and its arm (issue #668) reads Back before Start, matching how the row is laid out
